schema_note: Per-class directional panels for Stage 4.5 bidirectional decomposition. Each panel carries CpG-level direction (+1 disease-up, -1 disease-down) plus the training-set HC mean/SD used to compute z-scores at runtime. Direction-multiplied z-scores aggregate to a single signed directional composite per panel, mirroring the sealed VAL-051 a_dir_score formula. Pooled-entropy comparator (parent panel CpG list) is used to detect the bidirectional-cancellation signature where pooled is mute but directional is loud.

immune.description: Sealed VAL-051 Rule A panel: 7 CpGs selected from the parent 18-CpG IMM_CPGS_EPIC panel by criterion |Δβ| > 0.015 AND q_FDR < 0.10 on AIBL training split. Of these 7, 2 are direction=+1 (up in AD) and 5 are direction=-1 (down in AD). The 5-2 split is the actual SEALED breakdown — the pre-build cookbook reference '4 down + 3 up' refers to the 18-CpG parent panel, not the 7-CpG Rule A subset.
immune.future_expansion_note: v1.1 expansion via CPG-VAL-019 (cancer-positive vs AD-negative direction discrimination) will add additional immune-class directional panels for non-AD diseases. The v1.0 panel is AD-direction-anchored only.

panels._panel_pending_note: Seven of eight classes do not yet have sealed directional panels. The immune class is the v1.0 anchor (validated by VAL-051). For these seven, Stage 4 pooled-entropy A-score is the only A-score reported — no bidirectional decomposition yet. Future sealed VALs will populate per-class panels per documented evidence anchors. Until then, Stage 4.5 returns NO_PANEL for these classes (not an error — a known data gap, declared honestly).
